title: piper affine
intro: Piper affine, commonly known as the East Indian long pepper, is a perennial climbing plant native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Piper affine include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including lignans, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The health benefits of consuming Piper affine are thought to include antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, as well as potential anticancer and anti-diabetic effects.
